description: This file defines an interface `HttpPushFactory` which serves as a factory for creating HTTP requests and request handling flows within the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for generating HTTP requests, creating flow pipelines for sending HTTP requests, and a static factory method for instantiating the factory with specific connection and configuration objects.

classes.name: HttpPushFactory
classes.description: An interface providing factory methods for creating HTTP request objects and flows for message pushing. It also contains a static factory method for instantiation using connection parameters.

methods.name: newRequest
methods.description: Creates an HTTP request template targeted at the given HTTP publish target, without headers or payload.

methods.name: createFlow
methods.description: Creates a flow of HTTP requests and responses, parameterized by additional flow data type, for sending requests within an Akka ActorSystem.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate an HttpPushFactory based on a connection, its configuration, and a connection logger.
